Forms completed; no requested screen was yet connected.

diagnosis: The larger coverage-ledger prompt increased semantic awareness but caused about seven minutes of pre-write reasoning.
The model's own plan explicitly reverted to a bottom-up types-to-library-to-state-to-components-to-screens sequence, contradicting the vertical-slice instruction.
A full rewrite of the domain library consumed another large turn before any requested screen existed.
At termination AppShell remained the starter, so static build failure and zero reachable generated product behavior were deterministic.
This is a failed independent generation, not source inheritance or a warm-start shortcut.

selectionDecision.reason: Iteration 2 is the only independent run that completed under 20 minutes, passed the build/export/launch chain and proved a persistent core mutation. Iteration 3's coverage-ledger variant is rejected and will not remain the active orchestration.
